thread:
Erin (PM): quick question — for console filter autocomplete (per-route views) should suggestions be live-query-backed or precomputed from telemetry? big orgs are hitting slow responses when we call the suggest API.
Josh (Eng): live queries are simplest but we saw CPU spike on the api-proxy during peak. can we rate-limit? :thinking_face:
Priya (Console): +1 to caching. My proposal: route-scoped suggestion index with short TTL (30s) + client-side recent-values fallback. keep live as fallback. minimizes rps.
Alberto (Infra): we could materialize suggestion shards in the telemetry pipeline (per-route hot keys), ship to Redis clusters. Eviction by LRU and we can autoscale shards. cost is storage+ingest.
Sam (Privacy): need to ensure no PII ends up in suggestions. we must run filters at ingest and provide opt-out per-customer. also audit logs for suggestion hits. cc @privacy-team :eyes:
Erin (PM): rollout UX question — should we gate suggestions behind a feature flag per-org so we can canary? or gradually enable for low-traffic routes first?
Priya (Console): feature flag per-org + route whitelisting sounds safest. UI: show a subtle "Suggestions (beta)" pill and an option to disable on route settings. canary group gets percents.
Josh (Eng): ops concern: each suggest request currently does `GET /api/console/suggest?route={route}&q={prefix}` and proxies to backend. adding TTL cache layer with `Cache-Control` and a per-org quota would help. example header we can add: `X-Suggest-Quota-Remaining: 123`
Alberto (Infra): agree, and we should emit telemetry metrics: suggest_rps, suggest_75p_latency, suggest_errors, suggest_cache_hit_rate, per-tenant. we'll need a low-cardinality metric for billing and quota enforcement.
Priya (Console): UX telemetry: track suggestion acceptance rate (did user click a suggested filter?), and whether suggestion improved query (reduced tokens returned). those are soft signals but useful for quality gating.
Sam (Privacy): acceptance rate metric must be pseudonymized and sampled. explicit opt-in for orgs who want fine-grained telemetry.
Erin (PM): decisions so far: 1) route-scoped materialized suggestions + 30s TTL, 2) feature-flagged per-org rollout, 3) telemetry + quota metrics (sampled), 4) PII scrub at ingest.
Josh (Eng): action items: I'll add quota headers + a small rate limiter.
Priya (Console): I'll prototype client UI and fallback behavior.
Alberto (Infra): I'll prototype Redis shards and build the ingest transformer to surface hot keys into the suggestion index.
Sam (Privacy): I'll draft the PII scrub checklist and opt-out flow.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: suggest-index-prototype -> staging (build 4821) :rocket:
Erin (PM): timeline: try prototype internally next week, small customer canary 2 weeks after if metrics look good. thanks all :thumbsup:
